menu_icon.style: Minimal flat icon for a fishing-tackle e-commerce mega menu. Single solid color #475569 on a fully transparent background. Bold rounded strokes, simple silhouette, centered, generous padding (~15% margin), no text, no shadows, no gradients, no photo details. Readable at 16px. Square 1:1.

hero_image.style: Lifestyle photo for a fishing-tackle e-commerce category page hero. Wide clean composition, natural soft light, subtle depth of field, realistic fishing gear arranged on a neutral background, no text, no watermark, muted natural colors.
